CrewMember.description: A pilot or cabin crew member on the airline's roster. A first name alone is not an identity.

Flight.description: A scheduled flight, known by its flight code.

Chain.description: Who a crew member answers to: their line manager, or the examiner who checks them.

Assignment.description: A crew member's place on a flight: operating it, or standing by as reserve.

SwapRequest.description: A request to give away a duty. requested_by asks, covering takes the duty over, decided_by approves or refuses it.

Delay.description: A hold on one flight and its cause. crew_notified stays empty until a notice is recorded.

questions.q: Who is Obinna Eze's line manager?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:CrewMember)-[:supervisor]->(n1:CrewMember) WHERE n0.crew_name = 'Obinna Eze' RETURN n1.crew_name AS crew_name

questions.speaker: solveig

questions.q: Who is on the roster for QX107?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Flight)-[:roster]->(n1:CrewMember) WHERE n0.flight_code = 'QX107' RETURN n1.crew_name AS crew_name

questions.q: How many swap requests are there?
Which swaps did Solveig Arnadottir decide?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:CrewMember)<-[:decided_by]-(n1:SwapRequest) WHERE n0.crew_name = 'Solveig Arnadottir' RETURN n1.reason AS reason

questions.speaker: paulo

questions.q: How many minutes was the catering delay?

questions.q: Is there a record that the crew heard about the crosswind hold?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Delay) WHERE n0.cause CONTAINS 'crosswind' RETURN coalesce(n0.crew_notified, false) AS crew_notified

questions.q: Were the crew notified about the delay on QX414?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Flight)<-[:flight]-(n1:Delay) WHERE n0.flight_code = 'QX414' RETURN n1.crew_notified AS crew_notified

questions.q: What reason and duty hours does each swap request give?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:SwapRequest) RETURN n0.reason AS reason, n0.duty_hours AS duty_hours
